leaves.heading: Unfair or deceptive acts or practices
leaves.text: A violation of this section shall be treated as a violation of a rule defining an unfair or a deceptive act or practice under section 18(a)(1)(B) of the Federal Trade Commission Act ( 15 U.S.C. 57a(a)(1)(B) ).

leaves.heading: In general
leaves.text: The Commission shall enforce this section in the same manner, by the same means, and with the same jurisdiction, powers, and duties as though all applicable terms and provisions of the Federal Trade Commission Act ( 15 U.S.C. 41 et seq.) were incorporated into and made a part of this section.

leaves.heading: Privileges and immunities
leaves.text: Any person who violates this section shall be subject to the penalties and entitled to the privileges and immunities provided in the Federal Trade Commission Act.

leaves.heading: Authority preserved
leaves.text: Nothing in this section may be construed to limit the authority of the Commission under any other provision of law.

leaves.heading: Commission
leaves.text: The term “Commission” means the Federal Trade Commission.
